failure_modes.recovery: Closed signals never reopen — create a new signal (the slot cap binds at creation).
failure_modes.when: a status move is outside open→fulfilled/closed, fulfilled→closed (closed is terminal)

preconditions: Soft close: set status 'closed' — signals are never hard-deleted (responders' threads still reference them).

description: Update a market_signal you own (optionally compare-and-set via expected_updated_at).

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

name: market_signal_update
